note: Central telemetry schema. This is the single place where a column's physical meaning, category, unit, role and relationships are declared for the AI Analysis pipeline. 'unit_status' is 'verified' only when the unit is established by the owner-provided data dictionary or by an independent data check recorded in 'basis'; otherwise it is 'supported' (consistent with data but not applied), 'unverified' (hypothesis) or 'unknown'. No unit is ever applied unless it is 'verified'. Unknown columns are never invented; they stay unmapped and are reported as such.

datasets.label: FLT single-file UAV telemetry
datasets.description: 33-column flight log: millisecond time, status flags, RC commands, four motor outputs, controller terms, roll/pitch, altitude estimate/setpoint, time-of-flight height, IMU.
datasets.documentation_status: Owner-provided column dictionary (2026-11-15) plus repository data checks; axis/sign conventions remain unverified.

time.basis: Owner-provided column dictionary states milliseconds; independently consistent with a 20 ms median sample step (50 Hz) and with d(phi_deg)/dt matching gx in deg/s.

phi_deg.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: roll angle in degrees.

theta_deg.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: pitch angle in degrees.

ax.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: acceleration; independent check |a| median 9.80-9.82 m/s^2 at rest (config/dataset_profiles.json evidence).

ay.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: acceleration; independent check |a| median 9.80-9.82 m/s^2 at rest.

az.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: acceleration; independent check |a| median 9.80-9.82 m/s^2 at rest.

gx.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: angular velocity; d(phi_deg)/dt vs gx agreement with t_ms in ms and angles in deg restricts the product to deg/s (config/dataset_profiles.json evidence).

gy.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: angular velocity; d(theta_deg)/dt vs gy agreement with t_ms in ms and angles in deg.

gz.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: angular velocity; same sensor and logging path as gx/gy. No yaw angle is present to cross-check the sign.

rc_roll.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: pilot roll input; raw command units are not documented.

rc_pitch.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: pilot pitch input; raw command units are not documented.

rc_thr.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: pilot throttle input; raw command units are not documented.

rc_yaw.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: pilot yaw input; raw command units are not documented.

m1.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: motor output channel. Values 1000-1622 are consistent with a 1000-2000 command scale but this is not verified, so values are reported as raw output counts.

z_est.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: estimated altitude. Scale/unit not documented, so raw values only.

z_set.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: commanded altitude (setpoint), subject to schema verification.

tof_h.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: time-of-flight height. Scale/unit not documented.

tof_mm.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: time-of-flight distance in millimetres, subject to verification. The column name is the only evidence, so the unit is NOT applied.

u1_core.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: controller term. Meaning beyond its name is unverified.

u1_cmd.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: controller term. Meaning beyond its name is unverified.

u2.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: controller term. Meaning beyond its name is unverified.

u3.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: controller term. Meaning beyond its name is unverified.

u4.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: controller term. Meaning beyond its name is unverified.

armed.basis: Owner-provided dictionary: arm status flag. Encoding (0/1) is consistent but the meaning of intermediate values is not assumed.

kill.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as a status/control flag. Its numeric encoding is NOT assumed.

rc_fs.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as a status flag. Encoding not assumed.

tof_ok.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as a status flag. Encoding not assumed.

tof_st.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as a status flag. Encoding not assumed.

blk.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as a status flag. Encoding not assumed.

aux1.basis: Owner-provided dictionary lists it as an auxiliary channel. Meaning not documented.
